category_title: Highly anxious or extremely shy students at risk of disengagement
scenario_title: Creating a digital picture about fairness
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a small group cluster using drawing software to create a digital picture about fairness and honesty.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please open the drawing software tool and create a digital picture showing your ideas about fairness and honesty.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks down at the desk, keeping her hands in her lap instead of touching the mouse) I... I don't know what to draw.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You can draw something about fair play or no cheating. Just give it a try.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stares at the blank screen on the drawing software, looking highly anxious) It's too hard to draw that on the computer. I don't know how.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just do your best. The rest of your group is already working on their pictures.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the mouse away and turns her chair away from the desk, refusing to look at the screen) I'm not doing it. I can't do it.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please open the drawing software tool and create a digital picture showing your ideas about fairness and honesty.

STUDENT: (Looks down at the desk, keeping her hands in her lap instead of touching the mouse) I... I don't know what to draw.

TUTOR: You can draw something about fair play or no cheating. Just give it a try.

STUDENT: (Stares at the blank screen on the drawing software, looking highly anxious) It's too hard to draw that on the computer. I don't know how.

TUTOR: Just do your best. The rest of your group is already working on their pictures.

STUDENT: (Pushes the mouse away and turns her chair away from the desk, refusing to look at the screen) I'm not doing it. I can't do it.

task.content: Creating a digital picture using a drawing software tool depicting their ideas and key message about the topic of fairness and honesty
task.learning_goal: Contextualised their understanding of fairness and honesty into a visual representation of fair play and ‘no cheating’

context.social_setting: Small group work in clusters of desks

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Where students fail to regulate their behaviour or manage the increasing difficulty of their academic work
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Work refusal, non-participation, or withdrawing from schooling
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Sense of efficacy about succeeding in school can decrease

behavior_patterns.condition: When facing increasing difficulty of their academic work
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Exhibiting behaviours that made full-participation in the classroom difficult, such as work refusal
